title: Ruston and the End of the Rainbow

pages.alt: Front cover: Ruston and the End of the Rainbow, with Ruston and Reese in front of their house under a rainbow
Page 1. Ruston and Reese lived in a little house. One day, the whole world turned gray.
Page 2. A gray airplane buzzed over the yard. "Where did the colors go?" Ruston whispered.
Page 3. Then a rainbow came down right into their backyard! "Hey, look! A rainbow!" Ruston held Reese's hand tight. "Don't be scared. I got you."
Page 4. They stepped onto the rainbow. "It's squishy!" Ruston giggled.
Page 5. Whoosh! The rainbow carried them up and away. "Wheeeee!"
Page 6. They landed at the far end of the rainbow, on a road of clouds. "Where are we?" Ruston asked.
Page 7. Captain Rainbow gave Ruston a map. "Follow the colors. Bring the small one. She sees what you miss."
Page 8. "I'm too tired to fly," said Captain Rainbow, and he closed his eyes. "We'll bring them back," said Ruston. "I know you will."
Page 9. Ruston and Reese climbed into the little yellow plane. "Hold on." Up, up they went!
Page 10. But someone was following them. It was Captain Gray, the man who steals the colors!
Page 11. "Children. Pretty plane. Wrong pilots. Pull over at the next cloud." "No thank you!" said Ruston.
Page 12. Ruston gripped the stick. "Hang on, Reese!"
Page 13. A big storm rumbled ahead. Lightning crackled, but the yellow plane flew right through.
Page 14. The road split into lots of paths. "Reese. Which one?" Reese pointed. "That one? Okay!"
Page 15. Out of the storm and into the blue sky they flew, following the colors.
Page 16. The rainbow road led them through gates of color, all the way to a hidden valley.
Page 17. They landed in a meadow full of waterfalls. On the grass sat big spotted eggs.
Page 18. "This is where all color comes from, these dinosaur eggs!" Red, orange, green, blue, and purple eggs began to crack.
Page 19. Out popped baby dinosaurs, glowing with color!
Page 20. Ruston and Reese smiled. They had never seen anything so wonderful.
Page 21. Then the biggest egg of all cracked open. Out came a rainbow T-rex! "Awww. It's a baby."
Page 22. All the little dinosaurs gathered around the rainbow T-rex.
Page 23. Reese walked right up and put her hand on its nose. The T-rex blinked. "...It likes you," Ruston whispered.
Page 24. Uh-oh. Captain Gray's plane landed in the meadow.
Page 25. Out stepped Captain Gray, carrying an empty jar.
Page 26. He scooped a ribbon of rainbow into his jar. The meadow grew dim.
Page 27. Then Captain Gray swung his net at Reese! "Hey! That's not yours!"
Page 28. He grabbed Reese and ran for his plane.
Page 29. Ruston climbed onto the rainbow T-rex. "Please. Get her."
Page 30. Captain Gray's plane roared into the sky, with Reese inside.
Page 31. The rainbow T-rex ran and ran, with Ruston holding on tight.
Page 32. Then the T-rex opened rainbow wings, and they flew!
Page 33. "Faster!" Ruston shouted into the wind.
Page 34. They flew right up next to Captain Gray's plane.
Page 35. Captain Gray zoomed into a dark crack in the rainbow. The T-rex flew in after him.
Page 36. Inside was a giant room full of stolen colors in jars. "Reese! Jump on three!"
Page 37. Reese stood up on the seat and gave a brave nod.
Page 38. "One... two..." Reese jumped early, on two!
Page 39. Whoosh! Reese flew through the air toward her brother.
Page 40. Ruston caught her. "I said THREE!"
Page 41. Reese hugged her big brother tight. She was safe.
Page 42. All around them, shelves and shelves of jars held the colors Captain Gray had taken.
Page 43. Captain Gray grabbed for a jar, and the colors spilled all over him!
Page 44. Pop! The jars burst, and the colors splashed everywhere.
Page 45. The rainbow T-rex burst through the wall and out into the bright blue sky.
Page 46. Captain Gray sat in the mess, covered in color. "This is not over!" "Yes it is!" said Ruston.
Page 47. They flew back to the meadow, where a shining ring of rainbow light was waiting.
Page 48. This was the true end of the rainbow, where all the colors are born.
Page 49. The colors were safe again, and all the baby dinosaurs were happy.
Page 50. Ruston found something golden, shining in the grass.
Page 51. "I can't read yet. ...But it's ours," said Ruston. "We're not selling it." Reese nodded, very serious.
Page 52. Then the rainbow T-rex carried them home, over the canyon, as the sun went down.
Page 53. They flew high above the clouds, all the way home.
Page 54. Below them, their yard was still gray.
Page 55. The T-rex landed softly, and the colors came rushing back!
Page 56. Reese hugged the rainbow T-rex goodbye.
Page 57. Then the T-rex stepped back into the rainbow. "Bye, buddy," said Ruston softly.
Page 58. Ruston looked at his golden treasure. It glowed in his hand.
Page 59. He held it close to his heart and smiled.
Page 60. Mom and Dad came running out of the house.
Page 61. Everyone hugged. "Again," said Reese. "...You can TALK?!" said Ruston. Then he grinned. "Tomorrow. If it rains."
